allow: Bash(powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetAdapter | Select-Object Name, InterfaceDescription, Status | Format-Table -AutoSize")

Bash(powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "Get-PrinterProperty -PrinterName 'Samsung ML-375x Series PCL 6' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object PropertyName, Value | ConvertTo-Json -Compress")
